reasons_add: Al-Samarrai contrasts these greatest losers with the losers of 16:107-108: the former also obstructed God's path and misled others, bringing multiplied punishment, while the latter preferred worldly life without that added harm to others.

Al-Samarrai says they obstructed God's path and misled others, so their punishment was multiplied; he contrasts them with the people of 16:107-108, who preferred worldly life but did not add that harm to others.
Al-Samarrai links the judgment to 11:19-21: their obstruction of God's path and misleading of others brought multiplied punishment.
